title: Internal: Retrieving Bank Account Transaction History
summary: This document explains how agents retrieve bank account transaction history for checking or savings using the get_bank_account_transactions_9173(account_id) tool, which returns all transactions in reverse chronological order. It also lists transaction fields (transaction_id, account_id, date MM/DD/YYYY, description, amount in USD, type, and status posted/pending).
faqs: How do I retrieve a customer’s bank account transaction history for a checking or savings account?
Which tool should I use (get_bank_account_transactions_9173) and what input does it require (account_id)?
Are transactions returned newest-first or oldest-first, and in what order?
What fields are included in each transaction record (transaction_id, date format, description, amount, type, status)?
What are the allowed transaction types I might see (e.g., atm_withdrawal, monthly_fee, overdraft_fee, fee_rebate)?
How do I interpret transaction amounts and statuses (positive/negative amounts; posted vs pending)?
